description: This file is a FastAPI web server implementation for a subtitle synchronization platform. It defines REST API endpoints for subtitle correction and generation, handling file uploads, and returning processed subtitle files. The code includes middleware setup, temporary file management, and placeholder logic for the core subtitle processing functions.

methods.name: str _move_upload_to_temp(uploaded_file: UploadFile, suffix: str = "")
methods.description: Saves an uploaded file to a temporary location and returns its path.

methods.name: _cleanup_file(filepath: str)
methods.description: Deletes a temporary file if it exists.

methods.name: correct_subtitle( video_file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Video file"), subtitle_file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Subtitle file (e.g., .srt, .vtt)") )
methods.description: API endpoint for synchronizing and correcting subtitles based on video input.

methods.name: generate_subtitle( video_file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Video file"), language: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: API endpoint to generate subtitles for uploaded videos.

methods.name: get_websocket_usage()
methods.description: Returns information about WebSocket support (not currently implemented).
